content: Model Context Protocol (MCP): MCP is a standard for AI to connect to tools/data. Server exposes Resources (data), Tools (functions), Prompts (templates). Client is AI app that connects to Server. Transport: stdio (local) or HTTP+SSE (remote). SDKs: Python (mcp), Node (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk). Best Practice: Always use input schemas and error handling in MCP servers.
